mapper.select: SELECT * FROM com_project_contract_history WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND source_system='DPPMS' AND source_row_id=#{query.sourceRowId} AND source_revision_hash=#{query.sourceRevisionHash} FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM com_project_contract_history WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY source_row_id,source_revision_hash,id LIMIT #{query.limit} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_project_contract_history WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND deleted=0

SELECT DISTINCT c.id FROM com_contract c JOIN com_project_contract_relation r ON r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.contract_id=c.id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND r.project_id=#{query.projectId} AND CAST(c.contract_no AS BINARY)=CAST(#{query.contractNo} AS BINARY) AND c.deleted=0 AND r.deleted=0 AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND (r.effective_from IS NULL OR r.effective_from <=#{query.at}) AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to >#{query.at})
